typeToConfirm.$description: TypeToConfirm's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--type-to-confirm-<name>) on the page, a container or one TypeToConfirm, and every TypeToConfirm inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

gap.$description: Space between the field and the button (12px).

phrase-weight.$description: The phrase's weight in the label.
